mapper.select: select id, user_id, provider, provider_subject, email_at_provider, display_name_at_provider, avatar_url_at_provider, created_at, updated_at from auth_oauth_accounts where provider = #{provider} and provider_subject = #{providerSubject}
mapper.insert: insert into auth_password_credentials ( user_id, password_hash, reset_required, temporary_password_expires_at, temporary_password_consumed_at, password_changed_at, reset_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, FALSE, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select credential.id, credential.user_id, credential.password_hash, credential.reset_required, credential.temporary_password_expires_at, credential.temporary_password_consumed_at, credential.password_changed_at, credential.reset_by, credential.created_at, credential.updated_at from auth_password_credentials credential inner join auth_users users on users.id = credential.user_id where users.email_normalized = #{emailNormalized}

select id, user_id, password_hash, reset_required, temporary_password_expires_at, temporary_password_consumed_at, password_changed_at, reset_by, created_at, updated_at from auth_password_credentials where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update auth_password_credentials set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, reset_required = TRUE, temporary_password_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, temporary_password_consumed_at = NULL, reset_by = #{resetBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where user_id = #{userId}

update auth_password_credentials set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, reset_required = FALSE, temporary_password_expires_at = NULL, temporary_password_consumed_at = NULL, password_changed_at = #{changedAt}, reset_by = NULL, updated_at = #{changedAt} where user_id = #{userId} and reset_required = TRUE and temporary_password_consumed_at is not null
mapper.insert: insert into auth_password_credentials ( user_id, password_hash, reset_required, temporary_password_expires_at, temporary_password_consumed_at, password_changed_at, reset_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, FALSE, NULL, NULL, #{changedAt}, NULL, #{changedAt}, #{changedAt} ) on conflict (user_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update auth_password_credentials set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, reset_required = FALSE, temporary_password_expires_at = NULL, temporary_password_consumed_at = NULL, password_changed_at = #{changedAt}, reset_by = NULL, updated_at = #{changedAt} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into auth_oauth_accounts ( user_id, provider, provider_subject, email_at_provider, display_name_at_provider, avatar_url_at_provider, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerSubject}, #{emailAtProvider}, #{displayNameAtProvider}, #{avatarUrlAtProvider}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
